resources.string: Choose a UTF-8 text file with one YouTube video URL per line (up to 1 MiB and 2,000 lines). Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. Watch, Shorts and live video links are supported. Playlist and channel URLs are not imported.\n\nVideo details are fetched before saving, which requires internet access for videos not already saved. Keep this dialog open until complete. Cancelling stops before saving if the import has not already committed.
